title: Add project_origin scoping to LessonsDb::query_for_context
description: Codex review finding from sutra/152: query_for_context() ignores project_origin, so a lesson stored for project A on a common symbol (main, init, build) will surface in project B's sutra_read. Add workspace/project identity parameter and default to same-origin plus explicitly global lessons.
execution_record: Added project parameter to query_for_context. SQL filter: project_origin IS NULL OR project_origin = ?2 OR ?2 IS NULL. sutra_read derives project slug from workspace_root dir name. Test covers 3-lesson cross-project isolation scenario.
